t: High performance carbon steel blades offering coarse, fine and curved cuts in a variety of materials including wood, laminates and plastics. Slim, narrow-angled tooth design for clean cutting with less material breakout. Includes 2 extra-thick blades for fast, straight cutting in wood up to 60mm thick.
b: Cuts Wood, Plywood, Laminates, Plastic, Fibreboards & Chipboards
